customer.title: Customers
customer.createNotice: The password defaults to 123456 and can be changed. Customers receive no admin roles.
customer.resultNotice: Copy and securely keep or deliver the username and password. The password will not be shown again after closing.
customer.createRequired: Enter a username, nickname and password
customer.resetPasswordNotice: The new password defaults to 123456 and can be changed. The old password and existing desktop grants will be revoked immediately.
customer.freezeNotice: Freezing immediately revokes every device authorization for this customer.
customer.unfreezeNotice: Unfreezing does not restore old authorizations. The customer must sign in again.
